title: Modal for everything
summary: Using modal dialogs for ordinary navigation, onboarding, minor information, or reversible actions interrupts context and creates unnecessary focus complexity.
problem: Frequent modals fragment workflows and train users to dismiss overlays without reading.
use_when: Auditing interfaces with many dialogs that do not require an interruption or protected decision context
avoid_when: A true modal task must block interaction with the underlying page until resolved
rationale: Modal behavior has strong interaction consequences and should match the task.
Inline or navigable surfaces are often easier to understand and recover from.

signals: informational content opens modal despite having a natural inline or page location
routine reversible actions require confirmation dialog
